descriptions.en: An army composed of vapor-level Specter clones to be used in defense of the clan's Solar Rail. This Specter army will persist for one conflict.
descriptions.zh: 一支由幻雾等级魅影复制人所组成的军团，用来防御氏族的星际轨道。这支魅影军团可以坚持一场战斗。

descriptions.en: An army composed of force-level Specter clones to be used in defense of the clan's Solar Rail. This Specter army will persist for three conflicts.
descriptions.zh: 一支由原力等级魅影复制人所组成的军团，用来防御氏族的星际轨道。这支魅影军团可以坚持三场战斗。

descriptions.en: An army composed of cosmic-level Specter clones to be used in defense of the clan's Solar Rail. This Specter army will persist for four conflicts.
descriptions.zh: 一支由无极等级魅影复制人所组成的军团，用来防御氏族的星际轨道。这支魅影军团可以坚持四场战斗。

descriptions.en: An army composed of phase-level Specter clones to be used in defense of the clan's Solar Rail. This Specter army will persist for two conflicts.
descriptions.zh: 一支由相位等级魅影复制人所组成的军团，用来防御氏族的星际轨道。这支魅影军团可以坚持两场战斗。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to send forth a spectral axe during aerial and slide attacks in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下重击具有在空中和滑行攻击时发出一把光谱战斧的能力。

names.zh: 认知 & 冲击灵化之源

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to launch target-seeking fireballs that ricochet toward enemies in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下具有发射自动瞄准并弹向敌人的火球的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to temporarily increase Range and inflict guaranteed <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status for all attacks after a successful slide attack in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这把武器的技能，在灵化形态下成功进行滑行攻击后，暂时增加攻击范围同时其所有攻击都可造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire three short-range beams that chain link enemies in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下发射三道短程光束链接敌人的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to gain Radial <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage with each shot in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下每次射击具有范围 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire projectiles that pull enemies into a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage explosion in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下发射投射物将敌人拉入 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害爆炸中的能力。

descriptions.en: Awaken this weapon's ability to fire embedding projectiles that explode with <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in Incarnon Form.
descriptions.zh: 唤醒这个武器在灵化形态下发射造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害爆炸的嵌入式投射物的能力。

descriptions.en: An integral building block in the construction of Tenno relays.
descriptions.zh: Tenno 中继站构造中的一个组成部分。

descriptions.en:
This living mass can produce weaponized toxins for weaponry.

Location: Clan Research (Bio Lab in the Dojo) and Infested Outbreak Invasion Rewards
descriptions.zh:
此生体聚合物可以制造出可供武器使用的毒素。 

获取地点：生物实验室（氏族道场）和 Infested 爆发奖励

descriptions.en: Corpus Scouts are hiding in the Void. Use this key to find their ships and hunt them down!
descriptions.zh: Corpus 侦查员隐藏在虚空中。使用此钥匙可以找到他们的船舰来进行追捕！

descriptions.en:
Detonite injectors are the basis for explosive and incendiary weapons.

Location: Clan Research (Chem Lab in the Dojo) and Grineer Invasion Rewards
descriptions.zh:
爆燃喷射器是爆炸和燃烧类武器的基础。

获取地点：化学实验室（氏族道场）和 Grineer 入侵任务奖励

descriptions.en:
ClanTech weaponized containment field to contain superheated substances.

Location: Clan Research (Energy Lab in the Dojo) and Corpus Invasion Rewards
descriptions.zh:
氏族技术人员利用能量包围力场控制高热能物质以利于武器化。

获取地点：（道场中）能源实验室的氏族研究和 Corpus 入侵任务奖励

descriptions.en:
Upgrades the Orbiter's Foundry with the following features:

- Allows construction of Landing Craft
- Allows construction of Air Support Charges

Equip Air Support Charges in your Loadout's Gear.
descriptions.zh:
将轨道飞行器的铸造厂升级，可获得下列功能：

－可以制造登陆艇
－可以制造空中支持呼叫道具

在「军械库」>「携带装备」中装备「空中支援呼叫器」。

descriptions.en: Allows the Incubator to breed Kavats.
descriptions.zh: 可以让孵化器繁殖库娃。

descriptions.en:
Upgrades the Orbiter's Incubator with the following features:

- Regress genetic aging of mature companions
- Egg incubation reduced by a day
descriptions.zh:
升级轨道飞行器的孵化器来获得以下功能：

- 回退受老化基因影响的成熟同伴
- 孵化时间减少一天

descriptions.en: Allows the Helminth to socket Archon Shards in the current Warframe. Archon Shards permanently enhance various stats.
descriptions.zh: 该模块允许 Helminth 将执刑官源力石嵌入当前战甲。执刑官源力石可以永久增强多种属性。

names.zh: HELMINTH 执刑官源力石模块

descriptions.en: Allows the Helminth to fuse Archon Shards into more powerful variants through Coalescent Fusion and Ascent Fusion.
descriptions.zh: 通过联结融合和升华融合，可让 Helminth 融合执刑官源力石来获得更强大的源力石变体。

descriptions.en: Empower the Helminth in your Orbiter and unlock the transfer of new abilities to your Warframes.
descriptions.zh: 在轨道飞行器强化 Helminth，并解锁将新技能转移到战甲上的功能。

descriptions.en: Allows The Helminth to inject a Warframe with an Invigoration. Invigorations temporarily increase a Warframe's capabilities.
descriptions.zh: 允许 Helminth 为战甲注入活力。活化可以暂时增加战甲的能力。

descriptions.en: A rare Orokin instrument.
descriptions.zh: 一种罕见的奥罗金乐器。

descriptions.en: Unlocks access to your Clan's Dojo
descriptions.zh: 解开进入氏族道场的权限

descriptions.en: New Loka seeks help protecting a sacred forest from Grineer incursions, but are they ready to face the forest's true nature?
descriptions.zh: 新世间为保护一片神圣的森林不被 Grineer 入侵正寻求帮助，但是他们准备好面对这片森林真正的本性了吗？

descriptions.en: Ordis is determined to help a fellow Cephalon overcome a ship wide infestation.
descriptions.zh: Ordis 决意帮助一具中枢同伴压制一艘遭到广域性感染的船舰。

descriptions.en: Put an end to Alad V and his Mutalist experiments
descriptions.zh: 突袭阿拉德 V 的研究船，终结他的异融者实验。

names.zh: 异融阿拉德 V 刺杀
Limbo 头部神经光元定理

descriptions.en:
The Limbo Theorem quest cannot be completed without an Archwing

Piece together the Limbo Theorem to uncover its source
descriptions.zh:
Limbo 定理任务必须具备曲翼才能完成

通过拼凑 Limbo 定理来揭露其起源

descriptions.en: Seek out the Warframe Mirage.
descriptions.zh: 寻找 Mirage 战甲。

descriptions.en: Help Baro Ki'Teer raid an ancient Martian tomb for a mysterious treasure.
descriptions.zh: 帮 Baro Ki'Teer 突袭一座古老的火星古墓并偷盗一件神秘的宝物。

descriptions.en: Find Alad V’s laboratory and put a stop to his madness.
descriptions.zh: 找到阿拉德 V 的实验室并制止他的疯狂行径。

descriptions.en:
Dash forward, crashing through enemies and leaving an icy trail of broken vials.

Hold to imbue the next ability cast with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold.
descriptions.zh:
前冲直撞穿过敌军，并留下破碎药瓶的冰迹。

长按来为下一次的技能施放注入<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害。

descriptions.en: Launches a spinning blade of pain, dealing high damage and impaling enemies to walls.
descriptions.zh: 掷出一枚旋转的手里剑，造成高伤害并把敌人钉在墙上。

descriptions.en: Atlas' hardened gaze will fossilize foes increasing the damage they take, heal Rumblers, and create Petrified Bulwarks. When shattered, petrified enemies drop healing Rubble for Atlas.
descriptions.zh: Atlas 强硬的凝视将石化敌人并增加他们受到的伤害、治疗石头人，并创造出石化壁垒。当石化的敌人碎裂后，将掉出可以治疗 Atlas 的碎石。

descriptions.en: Using Silence surrounds Banshee in an aura that stuns enemies and will limit their perceptions and tactical response to gunfire and Warframe attacks.
descriptions.zh: 使用静音会使 Banshee 笼罩在一层光环之中，该光环会眩晕敌人，限制其对枪声和战甲攻击的感知及战术反应，并使他们无法激活自身的技能。

descriptions.en: A calming wave slows enemies until they fall into a slumber. Enemies woken by damage will be confused and disoriented. Short-term amnesia means all waking enemies forget anything that happened before the lull.
descriptions.zh: 平静的波浪使敌人速度变慢直到陷入沉睡。被击伤而苏醒的敌人会感到困惑和迷失。短暂的健忘意味着所有醒来的敌人都会忘记沉睡之前所发生的任何事。

descriptions.en: Jade summons an accusatory gaze that slows nearby enemies and dissolves their Shields and Armor. When the gaze falls upon allies, they can be revived from a distance.
descriptions.zh: Jade 召唤谴责之瞳使附近的敌人减速并分解他们的护盾和护甲。当谴责之瞳凝视友军时，可以将其远距离复活。

descriptions.en: Depending on Chroma's elemental alignment, an offensive area-of-effect is created. Chroma and its nearby allies are imbued with defensive energy.
descriptions.zh: 根据 Chroma 的元素属性，制造攻击性的范围效果。而 Chroma 和附近的盟友会被这股防御能量保护。

descriptions.en: Summon a Chyrinka Pillar that slows enemies. It pulses <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect.
descriptions.zh: 召唤出一根辐射柱体来减速敌人。它会造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害且必定触发异常状态。

descriptions.en: Wyrd Scythes surround Dagath and seek out nearby enemies. Those struck are slowed and suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. The scythes also spread Doom and extend its duration.
descriptions.zh: 命定镰刃包围 Dagath 并寻找附近的敌人。被击中的敌人会被减速并受到 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害且必定触发异常状态。镰刃还会传播厄运并延长其持续时间。

descriptions.en: Uriel heals himself and his demons. If his demons are dead, they are resurrected.
descriptions.zh: Uriel 治愈自己和他的恶魔。如果他的恶魔死去，他们将被复活。

挥舞 Narin 的细剑寒霜疾剑进行突刺，对正前方敌人造成 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害以及 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻和 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺异常状态。

每击中一个敌人可获得冰能量。

descriptions.en: Slam the ground to create a wave of incinerating plasma that knocks back enemies and strips their armor.
descriptions.zh: 猛击地面以产生一道焚化的等离子波来将敌人击退并剥去他们的护甲。

descriptions.en: In Night-Form, targets are put to sleep. In Day-Form, targets become more vulnerable to damage.
descriptions.zh: 〈黑夜形态〉使目标敌人陷入沉睡；〈白昼形态〉对目标敌人造成更多伤害。

descriptions.en: Emit a bright flash of light, blinding all nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 释放一道明亮的闪光，致盲附近所有的敌人。

descriptions.en: Sends a wave of razor sharp, crystalized ice toward an enemy, dealing heavy damage.
descriptions.zh: 制造一道由锋利冰晶构成的冰浪来对敌人造成大量伤害及缓速效果。

descriptions.en: Jump backwards and become invisible for a short duration. Killing enemies on their Weak Points extends the duration and heals Cyte-09.
descriptions.zh: 向后跳跃并短暂隐形。弱点击杀可延长持续时间并治疗 Cyte-09。

descriptions.en: Trap enemies in a carousel of mirrors, forcing them to attack visions of their true selves. Destroyed mirrors damage their attackers, as does the collapse of the carousel.
descriptions.zh: 制造一圈旋转的镜面吸引敌人，迫使他们攻击自己的镜像。镜面遭到破坏时将会伤害攻击者；当复数镜面瓦解时将对范围内所有敌人造成伤害。

descriptions.en: Impale an enemy on an altar of talons and siphon health for Garuda and her allies.
descriptions.zh: 以利爪构筑的祭坛刺穿敌人，为自己及队友吸取生命。

descriptions.en: Siphon kinetic energy from the area, charging the battery and inflicting <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status on nearby enemies. Hold reverses the process, draining the battery and inflicting <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status on nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 从附近区域吸取动能，为电池蓄电并为附近的敌人带来<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻状态。长按按键来逆转这一过程，通过消耗电池来使附近的敌人处于<DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害的状态中。

descriptions.en: Slash and stagger enemies with a crystal blast that inflicts <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status. Enemies afflicted with this Status Effect have an increased chance of dropping Health and Energy Orbs.
descriptions.zh: 用造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态的水晶爆裂切割敌人并使敌人失衡。在此异常状态下的敌人有更高的几率掉落生命球和能量球。

descriptions.en: Regenerate health as Grendel absorbs nourishment from enemies in his gut. While he digests, enemies that attack or are attacked by Grendel suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage and energy sources provide more energy. These buffs extend to squad mates.
descriptions.zh: Grendel 从他腹内的敌人摄取营养并恢复生命值。当他消化时，攻击 Grendel 或被 Grendel 攻击的敌人遭受<DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害，并且能量源提供更多的能量。小队队员也会获得这些增益。

descriptions.en: Throw forward a Gyratory Sphere that will implode after a few seconds or can be manually triggered.
descriptions.zh: 扔出一颗会在几秒后向内爆炸的回旋球体，或是手动触发。

descriptions.en: Cast a wave of energy that chains them where they stand. Each enemy held reinforces Harrow's shields.
descriptions.zh: 释放一道能量波动将敌人锁在原地。每一个被锁住的敌人都将强化 Harrow 的护盾。

descriptions.en: Increase the efficiency of your ammo consumption.
descriptions.zh: 提高你的武器弹药效率。

descriptions.en: Heal your companion and call it to your side.
descriptions.zh: 治疗你的同伴，并让它立刻回到你身边。

descriptions.en: Consume Energy to heal yourself and grant matching Energy to each ally.
descriptions.zh: 消耗能量治疗自身，并使每名友军获得等值的能量。

descriptions.en: Automatically succeed at your next hack attempt.
descriptions.zh: 自动完成下一次入侵

descriptions.en: Emit a pulse that adds stacks to Status Effects already afflicting enemies. The damage of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash, <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat, and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin effects, excluding those created by Sickening Pulse itself, are added together to create a new instance of the Effect with a refreshed timer
descriptions.zh: 施放一个脉冲，为敌人身上已有的异常状态效果叠加层数。<DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割、<DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰和 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素异常状态的伤害（不包括由「恶疾脉冲」自身产生的伤害）将被叠加，从而生成一个全新的异常状态效果，并重新计时

descriptions.en: Grant yourself immunity to Status effects.
descriptions.zh: 赋予自身异常状态免疫效果。

descriptions.en: Sacrifice Shields to reinforce Armor for a period of time.
descriptions.zh: 牺牲护盾以在一段时间内增强护甲。

descriptions.en: Instantly restore your shields.
descriptions.zh: 立即恢复护盾。

descriptions.en: Increase your parkour velocity.
descriptions.zh: 提高你的跑酷速度。

descriptions.en: Condense all <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Status Effects into a single damage instance.
descriptions.zh: 将所有 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割和 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素异常状态浓缩为一个单次伤害。

descriptions.en: Increase the strength of your next ability use.
descriptions.zh: 提高下个技能的强度。

descriptions.en: Stun an enemy; a portion of the next damage you deal to it will be dealt to all enemies around it.
descriptions.zh: 击晕一个敌人，对它造成的下一发伤害的一部分也将被应用于周围所有的敌人。

descriptions.en: Send out a short-lived Void Spark that is drawn toward the nearest Medallion, Ayatan Sculpture, rare crate, unscanned Kuria or unscanned Fragment.
descriptions.zh: 发射一道短暂的虚空火花指向离你最近的集团奖章、阿耶檀识塑像、稀有储存箱、未扫描的库利亚猫神器或碎片。

descriptions.en: Pillage a percentage of Shields and Armor of nearby enemies to replenish Hildryn's own Shields and Overshields. Also removes Status Effects from Hildryn and her allies.
descriptions.zh: 掠夺邻近敌人一定比例的护盾与装甲，用以补充自身的护盾与超载护盾。这也会移除 Hildryn 和她队友的异常状态。

descriptions.en: Summon Tharros, the shield of Styanax. Swing Tharros to repel enemies and reduce their shields and armor. Styanax regenerates health for every enemy struck.
descriptions.zh: 召唤豪勇，Styanax 之盾。挥舞豪勇击退敌人并减少他们的护盾和护甲。每击中一名敌人，Styanax 都会恢复生命值。

descriptions.en: Summon a tempest to rain down upon a target area.
descriptions.zh: 召唤暴风雨弹炮轰目标区域。

descriptions.en: Blast enemies with a wave of cursed sand that blinds them and steals their health.
descriptions.zh: 使用一波带有诅咒的沙尘卷向敌人，致盲的同时窃取对方的生命。

descriptions.en: Draw an ink effigy to absorb the damage dealt to Follie and allies. Below, a pool of ink spreads Inkblot. Kill enemies inside the pool to grow Follie's effigy and its ink puddle.
descriptions.zh: 绘制墨像来吸收 Follie 和友军所受的伤害。下方墨池挥洒出墨蚀效果。击杀墨池内的敌人可使 Follie 的墨像及墨池的规模不断扩大。

descriptions.en: Cycle through and shoot one of four tactical arrows. Cloak creates a stationary bubble that cloaks Ivara and allies. Dashwire creates a traversable zipline. Noise emits a high-pitched sound that attracts enemies to it. Sleep temporarily puts nearby enemies into a deep slumber.
descriptions.zh: 循环切换并射击出四种战术箭矢之一。隐蔽会创造一个使 Ivara 和队友隐形的固定球体。悬丝则可形成一道滑索。喧扰会发出高频声波并吸引敌人。沉睡之箭能使附近的敌人陷入沉睡。

descriptions.en: Bind a hapless target in living metal, entangling others who stray too close. Whipclaw will refresh the trap allowing it to capture more enemies.
descriptions.zh: 使用活性金属来束缚住一名倒霉的目标，并将缠绕过度靠近的敌人。以长鞭利爪击打可以刷新陷阱来捆绑更多敌人。

descriptions.en:
Surround yourself with Omamori Charms, each with a chance to have enemy attacks heal you instead of damage you. The number of charms is determined by Koumei's dice roll.

A roll of triple sixes grants invulnerability for the duration of your Omamori Charms.
descriptions.zh:
让御守护符围绕自己，每个护符都有机会使敌人的攻击治愈你，而非伤害你。护符的数量取决于 Koumei 的掷骰结果。

掷出三个六则在御守护符激活期间获得无敌效果。

descriptions.en: Casts a wave of Rift energy that damages hostiles while pushing enemies and allies out of Limbo's current plane of existence.
descriptions.zh: 释放一道裂隙能量波来伤害敌人，同时将敌人与队友从 Limbo 目前所在的位面中推出去。

descriptions.en: Loki deploys a holographic copy of himself that draws enemy fire. The decoy gains health and shield based on enemies nearby.
descriptions.zh: Loki 会部署一个自己的全息复制体来吸引敌人的火力。分身会根据附近敌人的数量获得生命值和护盾。

descriptions.en: Mag stuns enemies as she manifests a magnetic vortex. The vortex pulls in Polarize Shards and stunned enemies to place them directly in front of her.
descriptions.zh: Mag 所制造出的磁力漩涡会晕眩敌人。漩涡会将「护盾极化碎片」和被震晕的敌人拉近，并将他们放置在她面前。

descriptions.en: Gives an ally Extra Damage while jamming the guns of nearby enemies. This power shifts between team members.
descriptions.zh: 为队友增加额外伤害，同时干扰附近敌人的枪支运作。这个能力会在队伍成员之间转移。

descriptions.en:
(TAP) Temporarily reduce the damage Mirage takes from enemies.
(HOLD) Temporarily increase Mirage's weapon damage.
descriptions.zh:
（短按）暂时减少敌人对 Mirage 造成的伤害。
（长按）暂时增加 Mirage 的武器伤害。

descriptions.en: Cast fear into the hearts of nearby enemies, causing them to run away in terror.
descriptions.zh: 将恐惧感深植周遭敌人心中，使他们于恐惧之中逃窜。

descriptions.en: Blaze a trail of flames, scorching enemies and cleansing allies. Teleporting blasts the landing area with a ring of fire.
descriptions.zh: 点燃一道火焰的路径，烧灼敌人并净化友军。传送时可在落地点产生火圈爆破。

descriptions.en: Spawn an Infested pod that erupts with tendrils, latches onto nearby enemies and pulls them in. Enemies killed while held have a chance of generating a Mutation stack.
descriptions.zh: 生成一个迸裂出卷须的感染荚囊，紧抓附近的敌人并把他们拖入其中。在此期间被杀死的敌人有几率产生一层突变适性。

descriptions.en: Release a rejuvenating mushroom that emits a radial pulse, giving Nokko and his allies' <ENERGY> Energy and applying a buff to Ability Strength that lasts for a short time.
descriptions.zh: 释放一个可以发出放射脉冲波的复苏蘑菇，给予 Nokko 及其友军 <ENERGY> 能量，并在短时间内对技能强度施加增益。

descriptions.en: Creates antimatter particles that orbit Nova and attack nearby targets. Each active particle reduces damage to Nova's Health and Shields.
descriptions.zh: 创造反物质粒子环绕 Nova 四周，并自动攻击邻近目标。每个处于活动状态的粒子都会减少对 Nova 的生命值和护盾造成的伤害。

descriptions.en: Nyx seizes control of a target's mind, compelling them to fight for the Tenno cause. Controlled enemies have increased <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Chance. When Nyx shoots them, they also have an increased Damage Multiplier.
descriptions.zh: Nyx 控制目标的思想，迫使他们为 Tenno 效力。被控制的敌人会增加 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射触发几率。当 Nyx 射击他们时，伤害倍率也会增加。

descriptions.en: Focuses deadly energy within a target, dealing massive damage and removing all of its defenses, including Overguard. Enemies near the target also take a portion of the damage.
descriptions.zh: 将致命能量聚集于目标，造成巨大伤害并移除其所有防御，包括超宏防护。目标附近的敌人也会受到部分伤害。

descriptions.en: Launches a rollerball that charms foes to follow it. Combines with the Mallet to create a roving ball of sonic destruction.
descriptions.zh: 发射一枚滚球，利用音乐的渲染力令敌人跟随它。与槌音铮鏦相结合便可创造出一个徘徊移动的音波破坏球。

descriptions.en: Oraxia throws a creeping web to ensnare her prey. Enemies caught within the widening radius are trapped inside a cocoon that increases their Damage Vulnerability.
descriptions.zh: Oraxia 投掷一张蔓延的蛛网，将猎物困住。在不断扩大的蛛网中被捕住的敌人会被困在茧中，并使其受到的易伤效果增加。

descriptions.en:
Envelop Orion in an Astral Shell. Upon taking damage the shell becomes a decoy that draws fire until it's destroyed.

(HOLD) Swap to Sirius and use Jade Stars.
descriptions.zh:
将 Orion 包裹在星壳中。外壳受到伤害后会变成诱饵，吸引火力直至被摧毁。

（按住）切换到 Sirius 并使用翠玉之星。

descriptions.en: Dante's composition draws blood from nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage upon them.
descriptions.zh: Dante 的诗句从周围敌人身上抽出血液，对他们造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害。

descriptions.en:
(TAP) Kullervo charges a Heavy Attack, then teleports to his target and strikes. His rage-filled focus temporarily increases his Melee Critical Chance.
(HOLD) Teleport to any marked location.
descriptions.zh:
（轻按）Kullervo 为重击进行蓄力，然后传送至他的目标身边并发动攻击。他那充满愤怒的集中力会暂时增加他的近战暴击几率。
（长按）传送至任何标记的地点。

descriptions.en: Deploys a device that generates 3 pickups after a short delay: empowered health orb, universal ammo pack and energy orb.
descriptions.zh: 部署一个装置，片刻之后可产生 3 种拾取物：强化生命球、通用弹药补给包和能量球。

descriptions.en: Dash through enemies as a wall of sentient energy, leeching shields and health from any encountered, enhanced for thralls.
descriptions.zh: 化为一堵由 Sentient 能量组成的墙壁穿过敌人，吸取所接触敌人的护盾和生命，来自奴仆的效果受到增幅。

descriptions.en: Grants all nearby Warframes increased damage for a short duration.
descriptions.zh: 短时间内让所有附近的战甲提升伤害输出。

descriptions.en: Shedding her skin like a snake, Saryn leaves a decoy behind to draw fire from enemies.
descriptions.zh: Saryn 脱落如蛇般的皮肤，在身后留下诱饵吸引敌人的火力。

descriptions.en: Smash the ground sending out a radial wave of destruction. Those not killed by the initial blast are helplessly raised into the air, where they take amplified damage for a short time.
descriptions.zh: 猛击地面发射毁灭般的脉冲波。没有被最初的爆炸杀死的敌人会被无助地抛向空中，在短时间内受到放大的伤害。

descriptions.en:
Sirius conjures Jade Light motes that slowly regenerate over time. Attacking enemies launches the motes, dealing <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage and Status Effect.

(HOLD) Swap to Orion and use Astral Shell.
descriptions.zh:
Sirius 召唤翠玉之光微粒，这些微粒会随时间缓慢再生。攻击敌人会发射这些微粒，造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害和异常状态。

（按住）切换到 Orion 并使用星壳。

descriptions.en:
Blast targeted enemies with pillars of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage. 

Backbeat Timing: Ignite even more pillars. Increases the Duration and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage of Ripper's Wail when it deals damage.
descriptions.zh:
用 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害火柱冲击目标敌人。 

反拍节奏：生成更多火柱。该技能造成伤害时，增加撕裂者之嚎的持续时间和 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。

descriptions.en: Enemies fumble their weapons as they are whisked into the air. Nearby allies become immune to Status Effects. Hold the ability to cast the immunity onto Titania.
descriptions.zh: 把敌人扫到空中，使其丢掉武器；让附近的友军对异常状态免疫。长按此技能来使 Titania 获得免疫效果。

descriptions.en: Create a well of life on an enemy who will absorb Status Effect damage intended for nearby allies. Allies gain additional Health when they attack the target. If allies die, enemies in the well of life die in their stead.
descriptions.zh: 在敌人身上创造一道生命之井，吸收附近队友受到的异常状态伤害。队友攻击目标时可获得额外生命值。如果队友死亡，生命之井中的敌人将代替他们死亡。

descriptions.en: Valkyr lets out a rallying cry that bolsters Armor and Attack Speed for allies while in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range.
descriptions.zh: Valkyr 发出激励式咆哮， 为 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内的友军增强护甲和攻击速度。

descriptions.en: Deploy a roller drone that attaches itself to enemies and delivers bursts of arcing <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR> Electricity Damage to anything in the immediate area.
descriptions.zh: 部署一架可以将自身附着在敌人身上的滚子无人机，并向附近区域的任何物体发出炸裂电弧，造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。

descriptions.en: Launch a voltaic projectile that stuns and damages its target. A chain of electricity extends from the target to shock nearby enemies.
descriptions.zh: 发射一个能击晕并伤害目标的伏电射弹。一串电弧以目标为中心，散发式电击附近的敌人。

descriptions.en:
(TAP) Lycath hunts to sustain the pack. Enemies killed by melee attacks drop health orbs and enemies killed by headshots drop energy orbs. Increase the duration of Lycath’s hunt by killing enemies affected by 5 or more Status Effects.

(HOLD) Lycath guards Voruna with increased Heavy Attack efficiency.
descriptions.zh:
（轻按）莱卡斯狩猎以维系狼群。被近战击杀的敌人会掉落生命球，被爆头击杀的敌人则会掉落能量球。击杀受 5 个或更多异常状态影响的敌人来延长「莱卡斯之猎」的时间。

（长按）莱卡斯会守护 Voruna，提升她的重击效率。

descriptions.en:
Open a dimensional breach to overwhelm nearby enemies and cause them to release aggressive Surge sparks when damaged.
Wisp may also target a Reservoir to teleport to it and double the range of the surge.
descriptions.zh:
打开一个维度缺口来压倒附近的敌人，并使他们在受到伤害时释放出侵略性的电涌火花。
Wisp 亦可瞄准一个储能池传送，并倍化涌流的范围。

descriptions.en: Summon a radial pulse wave that ensnares and slows enemies, siphoning their lifeforce for the Death Well. Allies within the wave steal health with each attack.
descriptions.zh: 召唤一道放射脉冲波，来诱捕敌人落入技能范围并使其减速，同时吸取他们的生命力并注入「死亡之井」。处在脉冲波范围内的友军每次攻击都会吸取敌人的生命值。

descriptions.en:
Wukong and his twin become invulnerable and defy enemies to attack. All damage is captured, stored, and dealt back in a single furious strike of Wukong's staff.
Bonus Armor is then granted relative to the damage captured.
descriptions.zh:
Wukong 和他的分身进入无敌状态，同时嘲讽敌人，吸引火力。在此期间受到的所有伤害都会被积攒起来，而后 Wukong 会以一记狂怒的棍击将其释放。
根据积攒的伤害量，Wukong 还会得到额外护甲。

descriptions.en: Wield <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void Damage for all attacks from equipped weapons when activated.
descriptions.zh: 技能激活期间，所有装备的武器都会造成 <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>虚空伤害。

descriptions.en: Tear through foes with a trio of orbiting aquatic blades.
descriptions.zh: 通过一把三刃环绕的水形之刃来撕裂敌人。

descriptions.en: Launch a burst of massively dense air. Hold to send enemies flying, tap to pull them toward the burst. Damage increases per enemy hit.
descriptions.zh: 发射一团高密度爆发空气。长按把敌人击飞，轻按则把他们拉向爆炸中央。每击中一个敌人，造成的伤害就会增加。

descriptions.en: This heavy duty Archwing was designed for one purpose, destruction.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ELYTRON）这种重型曲翼只为了一个目的而被设计出来：破坏。

descriptions.en: Harness component of the Elytron Archwing.
descriptions.zh: 鞘翅曲翼的外甲组件。

descriptions.en: Systems component of the Elytron Archwing.
descriptions.zh: 鞘翅曲翼的系统组件。

descriptions.en: Wings component of the Elytron Archwing.
descriptions.zh: 鞘翅曲翼的机翼组件。

descriptions.en:
Allows archwing guns to be deployed in terrestrial zones. Install this device on archwing guns to compensate for atmospheric and gravitational forces not experienced in space.
NOTE: Deployment requires gear obtained from the Profit-Taker mission in Fortuna.
descriptions.zh:
允许曲翼枪械在陆地区域使用。陆地环境中存在着太空环境所没有的大气压力与重力，在曲翼枪械上安装这个装置就能抵消上述差异所带来的绝大部分影响。
注意：在部署时需要用到福尔图娜的利润收割者任务中取得的道具。

descriptions.en: This enhanced version of the first Archwing prototype takes the design to its theoretical limits.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ODONATA PRIME）第一架曲翼原型的强化机型，已将其设计为到理论上的极限状态。

descriptions.en: Harness component of the Odonata Prime Archwing.
descriptions.zh: 陨蜓 Prime 曲翼的外甲组件。

descriptions.en: Systems component of the Odonata Prime Archwing.
descriptions.zh: 陨蜓 Prime 曲翼的系统组件。

descriptions.en: Wings component of the Odonata Prime Archwing.
descriptions.zh: 陨蜓 Prime 曲翼的机翼组件。

descriptions.en: The systems built into this Archwing balance offensive capabilities with defensive countermeasures.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ODONATA）这组曲翼的系统拥有均衡的攻防能力。

descriptions.en: Harness component of the Odonata Archwing.
descriptions.zh: 陨蜓曲翼的外甲组件。

descriptions.en: Systems component of the Odonata Archwing.

descriptions.en: Wings component of the Odonata Archwing.
descriptions.zh: 陨蜓曲翼的机翼组件。

descriptions.en: Designed for quick clandestine attacks, the Itzal Archwing excels at striking from the darkness of space.
descriptions.zh: （英文：ITZAL）专为隐匿行动而打造，这架曲翼擅长在太空的黑暗中进行突袭作战。

descriptions.en: Harness component of the Itzal Archwing.
descriptions.zh: 刺影曲翼的外甲组件。

descriptions.en: Systems component of the Itzal Archwing.
descriptions.zh: 刺影曲翼的系统组件。

descriptions.en: Wings component of the Itzal Archwing.
descriptions.zh: 刺影曲翼的机翼组件。

descriptions.en: Transform into a winged guardian.
descriptions.zh: （英文：AMESHA）化身成一名飞翼守护者。

descriptions.en: Harness component of the Amesha Archwing.
descriptions.zh: 圣使曲翼的外甲组件。

descriptions.en: Systems component of the Amesha Archwing.
descriptions.zh: 圣使曲翼的系统组件。

descriptions.en: Wings component of the Amesha Archwing.
descriptions.zh: 圣使曲翼的机翼组件。

descriptions.zh: 一张用于制造阿耶檀识琥珀星的永久蓝图。

descriptions.zh: 设置一个为你战斗的远古守护卓越者魅影。

descriptions.zh: 安全地将 Grustrag 枷锁从你的战甲上移除。

descriptions.zh: 一个战甲的克隆复制品，可以部署来协助 Tenno 执行任务。

descriptions.zh: 设置一个为你战斗的疾冲卓越者魅影。

descriptions.zh: 部署一名 Clem 克隆人为你作战。

descriptions.en:
Autonomy processor for Robotics. A Corpus design.

Location: Europa, Neptune, and the Void
descriptions.zh:
机器人的自主处理器。Corpus 设计。

获取地点：欧罗巴，海王星和虚空

descriptions.en: Deploys a CORRUPTED BOMBARD unit to fight for you.
descriptions.zh: 部置一名堕落轰击者单位为你战斗。

descriptions.en: Deploys a CORRUPTED LANCER EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
descriptions.zh: 设置一个为你战斗的堕落枪兵卓越者魅影。

descriptions.en: In Arbitrations, where death’s shadow looms, life’s fire burns brightest. This light sculpture is a tribute to that survival.
descriptions.zh: 在仲裁之中，死亡阴影隐现之处，生命之火燃得最旺。这座光的雕塑致敬了那种求生的精神。

descriptions.en:
Modifies any slot to be compatible with any Mod Polarity.

*Umbra Polarity not included.
descriptions.zh:
改变任何槽位以与任何 Mod 极性兼容。

*不包括 Umbra 极性。

descriptions.en: This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe, Companions or Weapon and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes, Companions and Weapons.
descriptions.zh: 这个非固定形态的零件是奥罗金时代建筑中不可或缺的。可以改变战甲、同伴或武器的极性槽，并将等级重置为无等级。只能用于满级的战甲、同伴及武器。

descriptions.en: This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe, Companions or Weapon and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes, Companions and Weapons.

descriptions.en: Modifies a Stance slot on a melee weapon to be compatible with any Mod Polarity.
descriptions.zh: 改变近战武器上的架式槽位以与任何 Mod 的极性相容。

descriptions.en:
Soft metal used in microelectronics and energy weapons.

Location: Mars and Uranus
descriptions.zh:
用于微电子和能量武器的软金属。

获取地点：火星和天王星

descriptions.zh: 一个战甲的克隆复制品，可以部署来协助 Tenno 执行任务。

descriptions.zh: 制造 50个 费洛髂荚囊，能释出强烈的费洛蒙吸引感染者。

descriptions.en: Creates 50x Potent Pherliac Pods that releases powerful pheromones to attract the Infested.
descriptions.zh: 制造 50 个强效费洛髂荚囊，能释出强烈的费洛蒙吸引感染者。

descriptions.en: Deploys a MOA EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
descriptions.zh: 设置一个为你战斗的恐鸟卓越者魅影。

descriptions.en:
An amorphous solid. Possibly Orokin technology.

Location: Mercury, Mars, Phobos, Europa, and Pluto
descriptions.zh:
非晶态的固体。可能是奥罗金技术。

获取地点：水星，火星，火卫一，欧罗巴和冥王星

descriptions.en: A permanent blueprint that creates a NEURAL SENSOR
descriptions.zh: 可以打造一颗神经传感器的永久性蓝图

descriptions.en: A permanent blueprint that creates a NEURODE
descriptions.zh: 可以打造一个神经元的永久性蓝图

descriptions.en: Orokin modification technology used to super-charge weaponry. Doubles the available Mod Capacity on a Weapon.
descriptions.zh: 用来大幅度强化武器的奥罗金改造科技。能使武器获得两倍的 Mod 点数容量。

descriptions.en: A permanent blueprint that creates an OROKIN CELL
descriptions.zh: 可以打造一颗奥罗金电池的永久性蓝图

descriptions.en: Reactor used to super-charge Warframes. Doubles the available Mod Capacity on a Warframe, Archwing, and Companions.
descriptions.zh: 反应堆用于大幅提升战甲的能力。且能将战甲、曲翼及同伴的 Mod 容量提升为两倍。

descriptions.en: A replicant cloned from a Warframe which can be deployed to assist Tenno on their missions.
descriptions.zh: 一个战甲的克隆复制品，可以部署来协助 Tenno 执行任务。

descriptions.en: An integral building block in the construction of Tenno relays.
descriptions.zh: Tenno 中继站构造中的一个组成部分。

descriptions.en: Deploys a ROLLER EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
descriptions.zh: 设置一个为你战斗的滚子卓越者魅影。

descriptions.en: Deploys a SHIELD OSPREY EXIMUS unit to fight for you.
descriptions.zh: 设置一个为你战斗的护盾鱼鹰卓越者魅影。

descriptions.zh: 一个战甲的克隆复制品，可以部署来协助 Tenno 执行任务。

descriptions.en: Deploys a clone of the Stalker to fight for you.
descriptions.zh: 部署一名追猎者分身为你作战。

descriptions.en: Deploys a clone of the Surge Eximus to fight for you.
descriptions.zh: 部署一名电涌卓越者分身为你作战。

descriptions.en: Injecting this fluid into a Warframe will imbue it with the ability to fight autonomously alongside the Operator. Injection requires the use of the Helminth Infirmary, and the ability wears off after 24 hours.
descriptions.zh: 将这种液体注入战甲内，使其具有与指挥官并肩作战的能力。注射需要使用 Helminth 医务间，并且该能力会在 24 小时后消失。

descriptions.en:
Forma that can apply the UMBRA polarity.

This shape-altering component is fundamental to Orokin construction. Allows you to change the polarity of a mod slot on a Warframe or Melee Weapon to UMBRA polarity and then resets their affinity to Unranked. This can only be used on max Rank Warframes and Melee Weapons.
descriptions.zh:
可以设置 UMBRA 极性的 Forma。

这个非固定形态的零件是奥罗金时代建筑中不可或缺的基础构件。它可以改变战甲或武器的极性槽至 UMBRA 极性，并将其等级重置为无等级。这项物品只能用于满级的战甲及近战武器。

descriptions.en: Fuses with a Warframe to unlock the Exilus Mod Slot.
descriptions.zh: 融入一架战甲来解锁特殊功能槽。

names.zh: 战甲特殊功能槽连接器

descriptions.en: Safely disengages the Ascaris Bolt from your Warframe.
descriptions.zh: 安全地将蛔虫装置从你的战甲上移除。

descriptions.zh: 融入一把适用的武器来解锁其特殊功能槽。

descriptions.zh: （英文：CRONUS）一把用陶瓷打造的强大长剑。

descriptions.en: A blade forged using dark metals, capable of delivering innate <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with attacks.
descriptions.zh: （英文：DARK SWORD）一把使用暗黑金属制作的长剑，每次攻击都会附带<DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害。

descriptions.en: Nothing fancy but gets the job done and then some. With its electrified armor, this rough and ready mech can make the battlefield treacherous for the enemy with an arsenal of explosives.
descriptions.zh: （英文：VOIDRIG）虽然外表不怎么光鲜亮丽，但却能出色地完成工作。凭借其电能护甲，这款粗糙且整装待发的机甲能够携带大量爆炸物，让战场上的敌人陷入苦战。

descriptions.en: Casing component for the Voidrig Necramech.
descriptions.zh: 虚空锐将殁世机甲的外壳组件。

descriptions.en: This fearsome Necramech, fashioned in honor of the Entrati matriarch, is a robust front-line fighter. Favoring armor and health over shield strength, Bonewidow can grab and hurl enemies, deploy a heavy shield for personal defense, and cleave through opposing ranks with a massive warblade.
descriptions.zh: （英文：BONEWIDOW）这架慑人的殁世机甲，是为了纪念英择谛的女族长而设计的，这是一个强健的前线战士。相较于护盾强度，骨骸寡妇在护甲和生命值上更占优势。她可以抓起敌人并将其猛掷出去，或是部署一个重型盾牌来进行个人防御，又或是以巨大的战刃在敌军中杀出一条血路。

将狐帕菲拉体内的感染调理为 Madurai 极性。

descriptions.zh:

descriptions.zh:

副作用：尾部出现皮肤萎缩，导致露出血肉

descriptions.en:
Once installed, these delicate power systems fuse with a Corpus Obelisk's engines. Unused capacitors are therefore, highly prized.

Location: Railjack missions in Venus, Neptune, and Pluto Proximas
descriptions.zh:
安装后，这些精致的电源系统将与 Corpus 方尖碑引起融为一体。因此，未被使用的电容器非常珍贵。 

获取地点：比邻星域（金星、海王星、冥王星）中的航道星舰任务

descriptions.en: A rare bacterial entity that increases the spread of Infestation found on Infested Ships.
descriptions.zh: 一种罕见的细菌实体，可以促进感染战舰上发现的感染的扩散传播

descriptions.en:
Resilient components used to reinforce the plated sheets of metal strapped to Grineer Ships.

Location: Eximus units in the Grineer Shipyard Tileset, and Railjack missions in Earth, Saturn, and Veil Proximas
descriptions.zh:
用于加固绑在 Grineer 战舰上的镀金板的弹性部件。

获取地点：Grineer 船坞场景中的卓越者单位、比邻星域（地球、土星、面纱）中的航道星舰任务

descriptions.en:
A cell of encapsulated Void energy.

Location: Lua
descriptions.zh:
一个封装着虚空能量的单元。

获取地点：月球

descriptions.en:
Vital components used in the creation of Corpus photon-networks.

Location: Eximus units in the Corpus Ice Planet Tileset, and Railjack missions in Venus, Neptune, and Pluto Proximas
descriptions.zh:
用于创建 Corpus 光子网络的重要部件。

获取地点：Corpus 冰原星球场景中的卓越者单位、比邻星域（金星、海王星、冥王星）中的航道星舰任务

descriptions.en: A rare Orokin material used to create a tear in space and allow safe passage through the Void.
descriptions.zh: 一种稀有的奥罗金材料，用于撕裂空间以安全通过虚空。

descriptions.en:
Antimatter fuel cell that powers the Grineer Ships.

Location: Railjack missions in Earth, Saturn, and Veil Proximas
descriptions.zh:
为 Grineer 战舰提供动力的反物质燃料电池。

获取地点：比邻星域（地球、土星、面纱）中的航道星舰任务

descriptions.en:
A self-replicating fluid comprised of nanoproxies capable of independently repairing worn and damaged systems.

Location: Railjack missions in Venus, Neptune, and Pluto Proximas
descriptions.zh:
一种由纳米机器人组成并且能自我复制的液体，能够独立修复磨损和损坏的系统。

获取地点：比邻星域（金星、海王星、冥王星）中的航道星舰任务

descriptions.en: Orokin devices used for navigating the solar winds.
descriptions.zh: 用于应对太阳风的奥罗金设备。

descriptions.en:
A component used in secure Grineer communication networks.

Location: Railjack missions in Earth, Saturn, and Veil Proximas
descriptions.zh:
一块用于确保 Grineer 通信网络安全的组件。

获取地点：比邻星域（地球、土星、面纱）中的航道星舰任务

descriptions.en:
A parasitic growth that often infects Eximus units operating in Infested environs.

Location: Eris
descriptions.zh:
在感染者环境中的卓越者单位经常受到的一种寄生物感染。

获取地点：阋神星

descriptions.en: An organ found on Infested Ships believed to facilitate communication within the Infested Hivemind.
descriptions.zh: 一种在感染者飞船上发现的器官，被认为能促进感染者蜂巢群体思维的交流。

descriptions.en: Diriga shocks nearby enemies, and picks off distant threats, utilizing the Vulklok sniper rifle and the 'Calculated Shot', 'Arc Coil' and 'Electro Pulse' precepts.
descriptions.zh: 电气浮囊会电击附近的敌人，并针对远处的威胁目标进行攻击。使用「金工火枪」狙击步枪与「精算射击」、「电弧线圈」与「电光脉冲」等独特技能。

descriptions.en: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Ammo Case' as default Precepts, Carrier is a seeker Sentinel. Carrier also comes with a shotgun weapon.
descriptions.zh: 以「突击模式」和「弹药储转箱」为预设指令，搬运者是一个前锋守护，并配备一把霰弹枪。

descriptions.en: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube acts exactly as advertised, as a badass cube of 'deth'. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle weapon.
descriptions.zh: 以「突击模式」和「汽化」为预设指令，死亡魔方就像广告宣传的那样，是一个带来死亡的超棒魔方，内置死亡机枪。

descriptions.en: With 'Auto Omni' and 'Cordon' as default Precepts, this Sentinel is the ideal companion for long voyages aboard a Railjack.
descriptions.zh: 以「万用自修」和「防线封锁」为默认指令，这件守护是搭乘航道星舰远航的理想同伴。

descriptions.en: This brave deckhand defends his crew with Verglas Prime.
descriptions.zh: （英文：NAUTILUS PRIME）这位勇敢的水手使用冰凇 Prime 来保护他的船员。

descriptions.en: This ornate sentinel is an excellent example of late Orokin craftsmanship and styling.
descriptions.zh: 这架华丽的守护是呈现奥罗金晚期工艺与风格极佳的范例。

descriptions.en: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube Prime is the apex of lethal support. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle Prime weapon.
descriptions.zh: 以「突击模式」和「汽化」作为预设指令，死亡魔方 Prime 是致命支援的巅峰。其标配武器为死亡机枪 Prime。

descriptions.en: This knowledge hungry protector defends its master with Deconstructor Prime.
descriptions.zh: 这个充满求知欲的守护与分离 Prime 一同防卫着它们的主人。

descriptions.en: Both bodyguard and status symbol, the Wyrm Prime Sentinel was the last line of defense for high ranking Tenno in the Orokin Era.
descriptions.zh: 保镖与地位的象征，在奥罗金时代中，蛟龙守护 Prime 是高阶Tenno 的最后一道防线。

descriptions.en: With 'Scan Aquatic Lifeforms' and 'Scan Matter' as default Precepts, Oxylus was designed to assist in Search-and-Rescue operations through the harsh landscape around The Orb Vallis. Oxylus also comes with a Multron rifle.
descriptions.zh: 以「扫描水生生命体」和「扫描物质」为默认指令，奥克绪罗斯被设计用于奥布山谷外围严酷环境的搜救行动。奥克绪罗斯拥有一把多连穿甲枪。

descriptions.en: Shade Prime specializes in stealth and comes locked and loaded with the Burst Laser Prime. Together, you can dominate the shadows.
descriptions.zh: 阴影 Prime 专长隐形，它装载了激光点发 Prime。和它一同主宰暗影吧。

descriptions.en: With 'Revenge' and 'Ghost' as default Precepts, Shade is well suited for stealth gameplay. Shade also comes with a burst laser pistol.
descriptions.zh: 以「复仇」和「幽灵」为预设指令，非常适合隐匿型玩法，并同时具备点放式激光手枪。

descriptions.en: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Molecular Conversion' as default Precepts, Taxon protects its owner with shield restoration. Equipped with the Artax ice-beam.
descriptions.zh: 以「突击模式」和「分子转化」为预设指令，塔克桑利用护盾恢复来保护主人。它装备了阿塔克斯冰冷光束。

descriptions.en: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Crowd Dispersion' as default Precepts, Wyrm is a highly offensive Sentinel. Wyrm also comes with a laser rifle.
descriptions.zh: 以「突击模式」和「群体击散」为预设指令，是强力进攻型的守护，并同时具备激光步枪。

descriptions.en: Kitgun Magazine is replaced by bolts fueled by a recharging battery.
descriptions.zh: 将组合枪的弹匣替换为射钉，由可充电的电池驱动。

descriptions.en: Headshots increase Ability Efficiency and Ability Strength for a limited time.
descriptions.zh: 爆头会在有限时间内增加技能效率和技能强度。

descriptions.en: Reduces Movement Speed, increases Accuracy and Reduces Recoil when Aim Gliding.
descriptions.zh: 减少飞身瞄准时的速度，增加准确度并降低后坐力。

Fast-ignition, high-intensity mining tool capable of extracting the rarest of materials with surgical precision.

Can be used to retrieve Rare Gems on any Landscape. Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
descriptions.zh:
这是一把快速点火、高强度的采矿工具，能够以外科手术般的精确度开采最稀有的矿物。

可在任何地形中获取稀有宝石。远离城镇中心，将有更高几率开采出稀有矿物。
